title: Derived pullback commutes with derived tensor product
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lg^*:D(\mathcal O_S)\to D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category]. For a scheme $Z$ and $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_Z)$ write $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Z}L$ for the derived tensor product, represented by $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}\mathcal L^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] for a K-flat complex $\mathcal P^\bullet$ with a quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal P^\bullet\to K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and a complex $\mathcal L^\bullet$ representing $L$. Then for $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_S)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $$Lg^*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}L)\cong Lg^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_T}Lg^*L$$ in $D(\mathcal O_T)$, natural in $K$ and $L$.

proof.text: Unpack Classical.choose_spec of exists_derivedPullback in [def-pc-derived-pullback]. This supplies the recorded additive termwise functor F, its left-derived counit epsilon and invertibility of epsilon on every K-flat complex. Functor.ext applied to its object equalities and map formula identifies F strictly with tensorPullback. The adjunction recorded in [def-pc-module-pullback] makes tensorPullback a left adjoint, so it preserves the coproducts used in totalization.

Take exactly the module tensor isomorphisms chosen in [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Their two-variable naturality gives a natural transformation from tensor followed by pullback to tensor of the two pullbacks: specialize one morphism to an identity for each naturality equation. Apply the already proved total-complex comparison [lem-pc-total-bifunctor-comparison-iso] to the tensor total complexes of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Additivity handles the signed differentials, and preservation of coproducts gives its invertibility. Its map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX formula is precisely the required summand identity; mapBifunctorComparison_naturality is precisely the required complex naturality. After identifying F strictly, all equality transports in the statement are identities.

For K-flat P and N, [lem-pc-kflat-tensor-product] shows their tensor total complex is K-flat. The counit supplied by [def-pc-derived-pullback] is therefore invertible on that total complex. The quotient and localization functors preserve the total-complex comparison isomorphism. Composition of these two isomorphisms proves the final IsIso clause. No new resolution or K-flatness theorem for pullbacks is needed in this representative-level statement.
